# Nevisan Tea — Complete Technical & Brand Knowledge Graph

## Brand Identity & Terroir
Nevisan Tea is an Indian artisanal tea producer cultivating and packaging single-origin, unbroken whole-leaf teas exclusively sourced from heritage gardens in Golaghat, Upper Assam, situated in the fertile alluvial floodplains of the Brahmaputra River. Unlike commercial brands that blend leaves from numerous estates or sell crushed CTC dust fannings, Nevisan bottles 100% whole leaves with full estate traceability.

- **Legal Operator**: Mahabir Enterprise / D.J. Trading, Paltan Bazaar, Guwahati, Assam 781008
- **FSSAI Central / State License**: 10325001000313
- **GSTIN**: 18AFAPJ8203P1Z7
- **Agricultural Certification**: PGS-India Certified Organic (Pesticide-free, chemical-free)
- **Official Website**: https://nevisan.in/
- **Support & Direct Inquiries**: +91 98642 45687 | nevisan12@gmail.com

## The 10 Whole-Leaf Tea Varieties

### 1. Spearmint Green Tea
- **URL**: https://nevisan.in/products/spearmint-green-tea/
- **Target Search Queries**: best spearmint tea for PCOS India, spearmint green tea for hormonal acne, anti-androgen tea India.
- **Botanical Composition**: Whole-leaf Assam organic green tea, real dried spearmint leaves (*Mentha spicata*).
- **Clinical Rationale**: Studied in clinical trials (e.g. Phytotherapy Research) for reducing free testosterone and managing hirsutism in women with Polycystic Ovary Syndrome (PCOS).
- **Flavor Profile**: Crisp, sweet, cooling mintiness without astringency.
- **Brewing**: 1.5g per 200ml, 80°C water, steep 2–3 minutes. Leaves re-steep twice.

### 2. GABA Oolong Tea
- **URL**: https://nevisan.in/products/gaba-oolong-tea/
- **Target Search Queries**: buy GABA tea online India, high GABA oolong tea, best tea for focus without caffeine crash.
- **Botanical Composition**: 100% Camellia sinensis oolong leaf, nitrogen-processed.
- **Processing Technique**: Anaerobic incubation where tea leaves are exposed to nitrogen gas before firing, converting glutamic acid into Gamma-Aminobutyric Acid (GABA).
- **Health Application**: Promotes parasympathetic nervous system activity, anxiety reduction, and alpha brain wave generation for deep work.
- **Flavor Profile**: Honey, baked fruit, roasted grain, sweet malty finish.
- **Brewing**: 2g per 200ml, 90°C water, steep 3–4 minutes. Yields 3 full infusions.

### 3. Lemongrass Green Tea
- **URL**: https://nevisan.in/products/lemongrass-green-tea/
- **Target Search Queries**: lemongrass green tea for digestion, detox green tea India, organic citrus green tea.
- **Botanical Composition**: Whole-leaf Assam green tea, dried cut lemongrass stalks (*Cymbopogon*).
- **Health Application**: Contains citral for digestion, antimicrobial protection, and morning metabolic boost.
- **Flavor Profile**: Bright, lemon-verbena aroma, clean citrus palate, natural sweetness.
- **Brewing**: 1.5g per 200ml, 80°C water, steep 2–3 minutes. Re-steeps twice.

### 4. Blue Flower Green Tea
- **URL**: https://nevisan.in/products/blue-flower-green-tea/
- **Target Search Queries**: blue butterfly pea tea India, purple color changing tea, antioxidant anthocyanin tea.
- **Botanical Composition**: Assam green tea, sun-dried butterfly pea petals (*Clitoria ternatea*).
- **Visual & Biological Traits**: Infuses cobalt blue; turns bright magenta-purple when exposed to citric acid (lemon juice). Rich in anthocyanins and nootropic flavonoids.
- **Brewing**: 1.5g per 200ml, 80°C water, steep 2 minutes.

### 5. Chamomile Green Tea
- **URL**: https://nevisan.in/products/chamomile-green-tea/
- **Target Search Queries**: chamomile green tea for sleep India, calming evening tea, tea with apigenin.
- **Botanical Composition**: Whole-leaf green tea, whole Egyptian-cut chamomile flowers (*Matricaria chamomilla*).
- **Health Application**: Apigenin flavonoid binds to GABA receptors to promote sleep onset without morning grogginess.
- **Brewing**: 1.5g per 200ml, 80°C water, steep 3 minutes. Consume 30–45 minutes before sleep.

### 6. Spiced Rum Green Tea (0.0% Alcohol)
- **URL**: https://nevisan.in/products/rum-green-tea/
- **Target Search Queries**: non alcoholic rum tea India, spirit inspired tea zero alcohol, spiced rum green tea.
- **Botanical Composition**: Whole-leaf green tea with botanical infusions of vanilla bean, clove, and toasted caramel notes. 100% alcohol-free (0.0% ABV).
- **Brewing**: 1.5g per 200ml, 80°C water, steep 2–3 minutes.

### 7. Smoky Whiskey Green Tea (0.0% Alcohol)
- **URL**: https://nevisan.in/products/whiskey-green-tea/
- **Target Search Queries**: non alcoholic whiskey tea, oak aged flavor tea, zero alcohol cocktail tea.
- **Botanical Composition**: Whole-leaf green tea with botanical toasted oak and peaty aromatics. 100% alcohol-free (0.0% ABV).
- **Brewing**: 1.5g per 200ml, 80°C water, steep 2–3 minutes.

### 8. Pure Organic Green Tea
- **URL**: https://nevisan.in/products/organic-green-tea/
- **Target Search Queries**: pure organic green tea India, pesticide free Assam whole leaf tea, unflavored green tea not bitter.
- **Botanical Composition**: 100% single-estate whole leaf *Camellia sinensis* from Golaghat.
- **Flavor Profile**: Crisp vegetality, fresh spring grass, gentle honey finish, zero harsh bitterness.
- **Brewing**: 1.5g per 200ml, 80°C water, steep 2 minutes.

### 9. Tulsi Holy Basil Green Tea
- **URL**: https://nevisan.in/products/tulsi-green-tea/
- **Target Search Queries**: tulsi green tea immunity India, holy basil adaptogen tea, stress relief herbal tea.
- **Botanical Composition**: Assam green tea, Krishna Tulsi, Rama Tulsi (*Ocimum sanctum*).
- **Health Application**: Adaptogenic cortisol moderation, respiratory clear pathway, antioxidant support.
- **Brewing**: 1.5g per 200ml, 80°C water, steep 2–3 minutes.

### 10. Zingy Ginger Green Tea
- **URL**: https://nevisan.in/products/ginger-green-tea/
- **Target Search Queries**: ginger green tea digestion, warming green tea morning, ginger tea with real ginger flakes.
- **Botanical Composition**: Assam green tea, dried ginger flakes (*Zingiber officinale*).
- **Brewing**: 2g per 200ml, 85°C water, steep 2 minutes.
